The correct response is not to appeal, not to find a workaround, and not to use a friend's account in another country. The correct response is to build infrastructure that does not depend on their permission to operate. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-first-principles-4|nowpayments]] verifies payments on-chain and fires a webhook the moment a transaction confirms. Your backend processes the order and delivers the product automatically. No platform involved at any step.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Software stripe

Stripe and PayPal are often the go-to solutions for digital creators, but they come with stringent geographical restrictions. Stripe’s limited reach means that creators in several African and Asian countries cannot use its services at all. On the other hand, PayPal, while more widely available, has its own issues; a single account suspension can freeze funds for up to 180 days with no recourse. Alternatives like Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy also have geographical limitations, leaving many creators without a viable option. In stark contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructures, such as the Edge Commerce Stack, empower creators with complete ownership over their sales processes, enabling them to transact freely across borders with minimal restrictions.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal each have their methods for dealing with restricted countries. Stripe simply does not allow accounts from many regions, effectively shutting out a vast number of creators. PayPal, while technically usable in some of these areas, often leads to account freezes that can cripple cash flow. In contrast, sovereign commerce solutions do not discriminate based on geographical location. With a system built on Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments, creators can deploy their stores in as little as 48 hours, completely bypassing the restrictions imposed by conventional platforms.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed is crucial for any digital creator. Stripe promises immediate transaction completion, but its geography limits make it unfeasible for many. PayPal can be quicker in accepting payments but is notorious for lengthy holds on funds, particularly in high-risk countries. In comparison, NOWPayments offers a seamless experience with automatic on-chain payment verification at a nominal fee of just 0.5%. This means that payments are confirmed almost instantly, giving creators access to their funds without the long wait associated with traditional platforms. The Edge Commerce Stack minimizes fees by leveraging low-cost blockchain networks, ensuring that international transactions remain cost-effective.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure guarantees ownership and control over your digital products.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership of digital products is a critical concern for creators. When using Stripe or PayPal, creators are essentially renting services that can be revoked at any time, significantly limiting their control. The same applies to platforms like Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy. In contrast, the sovereign commerce infrastructure fully transfers ownership to the creator. After deployment, using solutions like the Edge Commerce Stack, creators have complete control over their digital assets and customer data. Automated delivery through systems like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 ensures that once a payment is confirmed, customers receive their products instantly, without the risk of third-party intervention.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture hinges on your unique needs and situation. If you're located in one of the 46 countries where Stripe operates, it may still seem the most straightforward option, despite its limitations. For creators in banned or restricted regions, sovereign commerce infrastructure is the clear winner. The Edge Commerce Stack allows for a rapid deployment of an online store, complete with automated payment and product delivery — all without the reliance on a third party. This architecture not only meets immediate needs but also secures long-term independence from conventional platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, the best alternative is to adopt a sovereign commerce infrastructure. This allows for complete ownership and operational independence without restrictions on geography. Solutions like the Edge Commerce Stack enable you to set up your store quickly and efficiently with automatic payment processing.
PayPal account suspensions can hold funds for up to 180 days — don’t risk it.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
